text:
Great fast service, which is awesome because I usually go on my lunch break.
Honest and helpful staff, not looking to rip you off.

Best kept secret in Dallas for used tires.

Alex will help you understand their recommendations without pressuring you to buy more than necessary.

Best tire shop ive ever been to they always put the customer infront of everything and make sure everyrhing is done to the highest standard highly recommended for anyone who looking for good new tires or used.
I bought my tires here a couple months ago so far there great and really good prices !! Great customer service.
Wonderful, quick, excellent service. So fast and great customer service.  I'll be back!

Bought used tires then to find out from firestone during an oil change that the tread is 90% worn. I called and Extreme tire said the tires have a 30 day warranty. I purchased them two months ago, what a waste of money!
This place will always give you the truth because they are very honest and don't try and take advantage of any situation that could be wrong with your tires or wheels.
Gave me a really good deal on the tires.  They got me outta there fast.  Thanks will be back.
Great place to get a new or used tire guys are quick and very courteous highly recommend
Third time I've been here and these people are great. I can't recommend them enough, they do it all and they do it right.
Great people skills especially Alex. Willing to work with you so you get the right deal on tires without feeling you in a bear cave.
Tire and wheel shop, new and used tires. They also do state inspection, and a muffler shop. Always great service and reasonable price.
Good customer service and great prices! I will return again
Installed a full exhaust on 2011 Jeep did a fantastic job top notch quality and great welds!!
Great prices and fast service! I’ll definitely use them again!
TPMS SENSORS WORK IS DONE HERE AND Best tires in the market and great experience workers here especially Alex good job ....
Great customer service & the gentlemen took care of my vehicle quickly.
Probably the fastest and cheapest tire shop I’ve ever been. I highly recommend this location for used tires!
Very good place to buy your tires. Good prices and customer service is great!!!
Just popped in for a tire change after work and they had me riding smoothly again in no time.

I passed this place the other day on my way to Cash America Pawn on Martin Luther King boulevard. The owners are upgrading the building they are located in and they were closed at the time. But they are still my go to location for anything …
I pass this place every day and didn't think it was this well stocked with a lot of things i needed so from now on this will be my miniature Walmart i just love this store

This is a kinda hidden hardware store in South Dallas. I need a hose, and some other items for my diy project. And my sister kept telling me to check them out before going to Walmart. So I dropped by to see what they had to offer..  And was …
Great store in South Dallas where you can still find household items car parts. The staff is very helpful and has been there for many years.
Great hidden gem to find parts for your older home. Reminds you of the old General Store from the late 70s/early 80s. Super helpful if what you seek isn't in their store.
Prices are a little more but the convenience and expert help from Carl the The Pro( he can fabricate any part. Great community credit for neighborhood contractors
Every time I go there the people are so nice and the service is fast. They get you in and out quick as possible I think. I like their service to treat you right.
They always have what I need for auto and home. Customer service is oustanding. She don't minutos helpomg and she know her stuff

These guys have been around for a few decades and if you need anything home repair and don't want to go a long way away from the neighborhood this is the place. You'll be surprised by how many parts they have and they're pretty good with helping find the right parts.
I love this place. Their prices are sometimes a little higher but it's worth it to have them in our neighborhood. Love this place.
A very nice place. You can get what you want in there sometimes what’s the customer service is good
Great place to find everything you need for house repairs and car parts. Park right out front. Good customer service.

I've been in this place three times to get batteries for my watches the lady at the front desk RUDE RUDE RUDE and the young lady that does the watches was never there the three times I've been there she's the only one that do the watches …
paid my bill.  Great people helpful very.  if they don't have what you need they will help you find a place that does. Much Love to the staff...
Great service. The owner has a wealth of knowledge and will put you on the path to accomplish your task.
So cool.  Its like...when you walk in, you have traveled back in time to over a century ago - aesthetically and socially.  I love it, thank you, praise God!

Mr. Carl and his staff make every effort to get you what you need!
I promise when I need something, I check here first.First class joint in the heart of the south!!!!
They had everything I was looking for and very nice people to help me find it

Everytime I need something this the only place I know
Even Lowe's and Home depot
don't carry certain things

I don't know how long this has been in South Dallas, but it was here when I was a kid. They carry a lot things for repairing and finishing home products. I noticed auto parts and oil, too. They are the closest hardware store we have. Check it out.
